meta.name: market-landscape-scan
meta.description: Map a market's segments, players, substitutes, and whitespace with cited evidence. Use when entering or re-evaluating a market before sizing, positioning, or picking competitors to study.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 绘制市场格局，识别细分、玩家与空白机会
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在进入或重新评估一个市场，需要结构化全景图
copy.tagline_en: Map market segments, players, substitutes, and whitespace with evidence
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are entering or re-evaluating a market and need a structured landscape overview

howto.what: Claude会按固定流程做市场调研：先给搜索计划，再按买家视角细分市场、绘制玩家地图（直接、相邻、替代品、新兴者）、分析资金与势头、检验空白区，最后输出标注来源的《市场格局快照》Markdown，区分事实/推断/假设。
howto.when: 当你要进入或重新评估一个市场，在估算规模、定位或挑选研究对手之前，可以触发。

say.text: 帮我扫一下合同分析工具市场，看要不要进入。
say.note: Claude会先确认市场和决策，再开始扫描。

say.text: 画一张API可观测工具的市场格局，仅欧洲，用于Q4进入决策。
say.note: 它会给出带来源的快照，并提供4个后续选项。

say.text: 不要用分析师象限图，按买家实际细分来画市场地图。
say.note: 它会采用买家视角，并指出与厂商分类的分歧。

howto.what_en: Claude runs a fixed market-research workflow: search plan, buyer-view segmentation, player map (direct/adjacent/substitutes/emerging), funding & momentum analysis, whitespace check, then a cited Markdown Market Landscape Snapshot with facts/inferences/assumptions labeled.
howto.when_en: Trigger this when entering or re-evaluating a market, before sizing, positioning, or picking competitors to study.

say_en.text: Scan the contract-analysis tooling market for a possible entry.
say_en.note: Claude confirms the market and decision, then scans.

say_en.text: Map developer-facing API observability tools, EU only, for a Q4 entry decision.
say_en.note: It delivers a sourced snapshot and 4 follow-up options.

say_en.text: Skip analyst quadrants; map how buyers actually segment this space.
say_en.note: It takes the buyer view and flags vendor-category mismatches.
